---
# About Me Section Module - Pulls from Excel
---

```{r}
#| label: aboutme-setup
#| include: false

# Check if aboutme data exists from Excel
if (!exists("aboutme") || is.null(aboutme)) {
  # Create default if not available
  aboutme <- data.frame(
    full_text = "I am a Finance Professor with over 25 years of extensive domestic and international experience in online and traditional academic program management. I create academic programs and courses that monetize academic effort and yield institutional revenue enhancement and stakeholder success. I maintain real-world relevance through being a Financial Professional Designation Exam Trainer, Financial Risk Management Specialist, Financial Market Consultant, Expert on Big Data, Implementer of Natural Language Processing, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning applications in Finance.",
    short_text = "Finance Professor and Academic Administrator with 25+ years of proven leadership in building successful, revenue-generating programs.",
    competencies = "Program Development & Growth • Strategic Planning • Budget Management • Enrollment Strategy • Faculty Development • Accreditation Leadership • Stakeholder Relations • Data-Driven Decision Making"
  )
} else {
  # Ensure columns exist
  if (!"full_text" %in% names(aboutme)) aboutme$full_text <- ""
  if (!"short_text" %in% names(aboutme)) aboutme$short_text <- ""
  if (!"competencies" %in% names(aboutme)) aboutme$competencies <- ""
}
```

```{r}
#| label: aboutme-html
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

# For HTML, display in the hero section
if (nrow(aboutme) > 0) {
  cat('<div class="profile-summary">\n\n')
  
  # Use short text if available, otherwise use full text
  if (aboutme$short_text[1] != "") {
    cat(aboutme$short_text[1], "\n\n")
  } else if (aboutme$full_text[1] != "") {
    cat(aboutme$full_text[1], "\n\n")
  }
  
  # Add competencies if available
  if (aboutme$competencies[1] != "") {
    cat("**Core Competencies:** ", aboutme$competencies[1], "\n\n")
  }
  
  cat('</div>\n')
}
```

```{r}
#| label: aboutme-pdf
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

# For PDF, the aboutme text is handled by the template in the header
# But we can ensure it's available in the metadata
if (exists("aboutme") && nrow(aboutme) > 0 && aboutme$full_text[1] != "") {
  # The full_text should be passed to the PDF template via the YAML header
  # This is typically handled in the main document's YAML
}
```
